scope.model_selection: Every raw TOML model row, including rows filtered out of completion presets.
scope.region: First-party API endpoints in the international profiles; no Azure, Vertex, regional or account-specific entitlement is inferred.
scope.unknown_policy: Unknown records insufficient reviewed evidence, not lack of upstream support. Missing features, similar names, family ancestry, and failed page fetches never establish unsupported.
scope.availability_policy: Feature cells describe documented contracts. Separately consult availability; documented is not an account-level availability guarantee, and shut_down overrides callability.
scope.freshness_policy: Each source and record retains its own review date; evidence_date is the latest review date. Tests perform no automatic network checks.
scope.retirement_policy: Explicitly shut-down catalog rows are retained in retired_models as historical evidence, outside active raw-catalog coverage.

basis_definitions.explicit_support: Official model card or API guide affirmatively documents the operation.
basis_definitions.explicit_limitation: Official documentation explicitly excludes the operation or this endpoint.
basis_definitions.documented_family: A guide explicitly names the exact model or bounded family for this operation.
basis_definitions.documented_alias: An official page explicitly identifies the alias target; no name-based alias guess is used.
basis_definitions.not_established: Reviewed sources do not establish model-and-operation support; the source points to the reviewed context, not negative proof.
